subject: Orion Health RFP — evaluation stipend allocation and visibility
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Leah Morales <leah.morales@orionhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion Health RFP — evaluation stipend allocation and visibility

Hi Raj / Leah,

Thanks again for the call earlier — excited about the opportunity to participate in Orion Health's inference RFP. Per our conversation, I wanted to put a concrete proposal on the table for an evaluation stipend and a short plan for how we can help you run a head-to-head comparison against the incumbent.

Proposal (high level):
- Evaluation stipend: $30k in platform credits usable over a 60-day pilot window.
- Technical support: 2 dedicated half-days from our Solutions Engineer team for onboarding and model tuning.
- Observable benchmarks: We'll provide a per-route latency/cost dashboard and a pass/fail checklist to mirror your success criteria.

Attachments: orion_rfp_requirements.pdf (PDF) — I pulled the key sections you mentioned; also attaching a sample MAP (proposed-map.xlsx) for tracking milestones.

If this works as a starting point, could you share the bakeoff window and any non-negotiable evaluation workloads (e.g., max tokens/session, privacy constraints)? Happy to adjust the stipend and timebox based on scope.

Next steps: If agreeable, I can loop in Karthik for commercial approval and Ben for billing/credit mechanics.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: orion_rfp_requirements.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orionhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Morales <leah.morales@orionhealth.com>, procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orion Health RFP — evaluation stipend allocation and visibility

Vanessa — thanks for this. The proposal looks reasonable as a baseline. A couple of asks from procurement/ops:

1) Can you make the stipend available as a 90-day window instead of 60? Some of our clinical workloads require longer runs.
2) Will the stipend cover cross-region testing (we want one test in us-west and one in eu-west)?
3) Important for evaluation: we need to know if we can invalidate fallbacks to your hosted variants (we need consistent variant matching across runs so the bakeoff is fair).

Also, the incumbent has offered to sponsor test credits if we commit to their platform for a pilot — we want to make sure Redwood's offer is visibility-forward (i.e., explicit mapping of spend to tests) and that we can get a short written note we can share in the RFP scoring pack.

CCing procurement for visibility.

—Raj
Raj Patel
Director, Cloud Procurement | Orion Health
raj.patel@orionhealth.com

Subject: FW: Orion Health RFP — evaluation stipend allocation and visibility

Team — forwarding Raj's reply. Key asks: 90-day window, cross-region coverage (us-west + eu-west), explicit spend->test mapping, and a short written note we can include in Orion's RFP scoring pack. They also called out that the incumbent is offering credits contingent on a subsequent pilot — this is likely a procurement play.

Quick context: deal ORH-2026-019, likely ARR $180–250k if pilot converts. Procurement is careful and wants very clear visibility and rules for the stipend so they can score consistently.

Suggested options (please reply with approvals/edits):
A) Approve $45k credits, 90-day window, multiregion enabled (us-west + eu-west). Require signed evaluation terms (DocuSign) to control usage and visibility.
B) Approve $30k credits but allow a single-region run and an explicit per-test accounting report (weekly) + two SRE office-hours instead of SE days.

Ben — need your take on billing/credit escrow and whether we should tie credits to HubSpot milestone (e.g., "evaluation-complete") so credits don't get spent outside the bakeoff. Marissa — if we go A, we'll want a one-paragraph note (signed by us) summarizing scope and how credits map to tests for Orion's scoring pack.

Quote from Raj below for reference.

Thanks,
Vanessa

---
On Sat, Aug 15, 2026 at 10:03 AM Raj Patel <raj.patel@orionhealth.com> wrote:
> Vanessa — thanks for this. The proposal looks reasonable as a baseline...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orion Health RFP — evaluation stipend allocation and visibility

Raj — thanks for the clear asks and for flagging the incumbent's play. Appreciate the transparency. We've reviewed internally and are prepared to proceed with option A with one clarifying constraint: the stipend will be $45k in platform credits, valid for 90 days from issuance, and scoped specifically to the bakeoff workloads you share with us in advance.

Key terms (short):
- Credits: $45,000 in Redwood platform credits, applied to Orion Health's account and valid for 90 days.
- Regions: Credits may be used in us-west and eu-west (cross-region testing allowed).
- Variant controls: We'll provide a pinned model variant for the duration of the bakeoff to ensure deterministic comparisons. Fallbacks to alternative hosted variants are disabled for the pinned model.
- Visibility: Redwood will provide a weekly "spend->test" export (CSV) and a short one-page note describing how credits were consumed that you can include in the RFP scoring pack.
- Administrative: Execution requires a signed evaluation terms DocuSign. Link: https://docusign.com/redwood/orh-eval-2026 (placeholder).

Ben and Finance will create the credit instrument and escrow rules; Ben — please confirm issuance lead time. Marissa — attached is a quick one-paragraph note for Orion's scoring pack; Vanessa, feel free to edit before we send.

Raj — if that all looks good, I'll send the DocuSign and we can get credits into your account within 48 business hours of signature.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
